title: Multi-slug lanes: TDD predicate scope and Builder contract scope are never reconciled — the second slug is silently undelivered and the cycle deterministically FAILs
summary: Cycle-1480 (batch-20260815c wave-2) dispatched a 2-slug bundle 'minted-phase-verdict-contract-unsatisfiable+dead-api-sweep'. TDD minted a cycle-wide ACS predicate suite covering BOTH slugs; the Builder's contract bound only the FIRST. Slug 2 (dead-api-sweep) was entirely undelivered (go/internal/core/phase_judge.go unchanged, no regenerated reachability evidence), predicates 006/007/008 red. Audit FAIL H1 verbatim: 'TDD minted a cycle-wide predicate suite covering both slugs while the Builder contract bound only the first slug; nothing reconciles the two scopes.' RECURRENCE: cycle-1483 (batch-20260816a) re-bundled the same pair DESPITE do-not-re-bundle notes on both items — notes do not reach the partitioner; the class fix must be structural (split at mint or scope-coherence gate), not annotation-based.
root_cause: Two phase agents derive scope from the same lane independently: TDD reads the full lane-scope (all slugs) to author predicates; the Builder's deliverable contract binds a single slug. No coherence check asserts predicate-suite scope == builder contract scope, so any multi-slug lane FAILs by construction after burning the full spine (~12 phases).
fix: Single-source the lane scope projection (never-duplicate rule): both the TDD predicate-minting input and the Builder contract binding must derive from the same lane-scope.json slug set. Then add a deterministic pre-build coherence gate: if the minted predicate suite references slugs absent from the builder contract (or vice versa), block at the TDD->Build transition with a named defect — before ~2M tokens are spent proving the mismatch. Alternatives to weigh at build time: (a) bind the builder contract to ALL lane slugs, or (b) split multi-slug bundles into per-slug lanes at mint (batching menus are exact-file-overlap only, so a split may be the simpler class-kill).
files: go/internal/phases/ (TDD predicate minting input; builder contract binding site)
acceptance: A 2-slug fixture lane either delivers both slugs or blocks at the TDD->Build boundary with a scope-mismatch defect — it can no longer run the full spine and FAIL at audit.
Predicate-suite slug set == builder contract slug set enforced by a deterministic check with a red-first test pinning the cycle-1480 shape.
Single projection source: one function yields the slug set for both consumers (grep-proof: no second parser of lane-scope slugs).
